component.name: Delve
component.summary: A fast, adaptable file manager for Linux

description.p: Delve is a distribution-neutral GTK4 file manager built for everyday file work. It combines five folder views, independent tabs, real file operations, archive support, tags, previews, and reusable command sets in one native Linux application.

ul.li: Icon, detail, recursive, treemap, and graph views with shared selection.
Copy, move, rename, duplicate, trash, restore, links, and conflict handling.
ZIP, TAR, and TAR.GZ creation and safe extraction.
Tags, folder colours, image thumbnails, and text previews.
Folder command sets with quick slots, parallel runs, and detached output.
Editable shortcuts, built-in themes, custom themes, and bundled icons.
Five synchronised folder views and independent tabs.
Complete file operations, archive creation, and safe extraction.
Tags, folder colours, previews, and inspector.
Command sets with parallel batches, quick slots, and detached output.
Bundled icon theme and offline application icons.
Complete user, install, build, release, and support documentation.
